from datetime import datetime

# Get current date/year from system time as instructed
now = datetime.now()
year = now.year
start_date = f"{year}-03-01"
print('now', now)
print('start_date', start_date)

# Roommates emails from earlier phone contacts
roommates = [
    {'name':'Anthony Harrison','email':'an-harrison@gmail.com'},
    {'name':'Anita Burch','email':'anita.burch@gmail.com'},
    {'name':'Melissa Bailey','email':'mel.bailey@gmail.com'},
]
print('roommates', roommates)

# Venmo login
venmo_pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_user = 'nicholas.weber@gmail.com'

venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_user, password=venmo_pw)
access_token = venmo_login['access_token']
print('venmo_login keys', list(venmo_login.keys()))
print('access_token_prefix', access_token[:20])

api = apis.venmo.show_transactions

def fetch_all_transactions_for_user(email, direction):
    total_amt = 0.0
    txs = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=access_token,
            user_email=email,
            direction=direction,
            min_created_at=start_date,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=20,
        )
        print('email', email, 'direction', direction, 'page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        for tx in page:
            amt = float(tx.get('amount', 0.0))
            total_amt += amt
            txs.append(tx)
        page_index += 1
    return total_amt, txs

sent_sum = 0.0
received_sum = 0.0
per_roommate = {}

for r in roommates:
    email = r['email']
    sent_amt, sent_txs = fetch_all_transactions_for_user(email, 'sent')
    recv_amt, recv_txs = fetch_all_transactions_for_user(email, 'received')
    per_roommate[r['name']] = {
        'email': email,
        'sent': sent_amt,
        'received': recv_amt,
        'sent_count': len(sent_txs),
        'received_count': len(recv_txs)
    }
    sent_sum += sent_amt
    received_sum += recv_amt

print('per_roommate', per_roommate)
print('sent_sum', sent_sum)
print('received_sum', received_sum)
print('total', sent_sum + received_sum)

from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); year=now.year; start_date=f"{year}-03-01"
venmo_pw=[x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_user='nicholas.weber@gmail.com'
access_token=apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_user,password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# roommate contacts
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='9503658964',password='ox6SqF4')['access_token']
roommates=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token,query='',relationship='roommate',page_index=i,page_limit=20)
    if not page: break
    roommates.extend(page)
    i+=1

roommate_emails=[c['email'] for c in roommates]

sent_sum=0.0
received_sum=0.0

for email in roommate_emails:
    # sent
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token,user_email=email,direction='sent',min_created_at=start_date,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
        if not page: break
        sent_sum += sum(float(tx.get('amount',0.0)) for tx in page)
        page_index+=1
    # received
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token,user_email=email,direction='received',min_created_at=start_date,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
        if not page: break
        received_sum += sum(float(tx.get('amount',0.0)) for tx in page)
        page_index+=1

sent_sum_r=round(sent_sum+1e-9,2)
received_sum_r=round(received_sum+1e-9,2)
answer=f"sent:{sent_sum_r}, received:{received_sum_r}" 
print('start_date',start_date)
print('answer',answer)

apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=answer)
